title: Approve a bounded RF measurement protocol
description:
Prepare and obtain human approval of a bounded measurement protocol and instrument plan. Identify exact configurations, known-payload sources, calibration and cable losses, uncertainty, sample counts, environmental conditions, limits, RF containment, abort rules and bench port-safety procedures.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Review only, with no ports or RF. authority.10 separately supplies scoped test-session authority. Instrument purchases, borrowing arrangements and external lab bookings require separately deferred external actions and per-action permission. Closed status without affirmative matching protocol approval cannot release physical tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Record the protocol review honestly; change requests, unresolved requirements and no-go are valid dispositions without execution permission. For positive measurement-protocol approval: Require recorded, scoped, explicit approval from Mark for the named action. Identify the protocol revision and session/setup scope. Quantitative thresholds and independent measurement/oracle methods precede testing. Missing instruments remain gaps; approval does not mean equipment was obtained or measurements passed, and authority.10 remains a separate gate.
